product.sinclair-apc286.summary: Sinclair APC desktop based on Amstrad’s PC3286 design.
product.sinclair-apc286.history: A surviving unit has a “Sinclair APC 286 by Amstrad” front badge and a factory label reading “SINCLAIR MODEL APC3286”. Its chassis and plug-in processor card match the Generation 3 PC3286 design. The PC3286 is documented at 16 MHz. This specimen’s processor marking has yet to be read.
product.sinclair-apc286.technical.hardwa: The photographed specimen has four SIMMs, VGA output, a floppy drive and a Seagate ST-157A-1 IDE hard disk. The precise board equivalence and original retail configuration remain unverified.
product.sinclair-apc286.warning: The power-on screen shows “AMSTRAD PC3286 (v2.3)”, 640 KB of base memory and 384 KB of EMS. A verified dump is still needed to check binary identity. Virtual machine creation is disabled.
product.sinclair-apc286.technical.specim: APC 286 specimen with front panel, APC3286 label, internals and power-on photos
product.sinclair-apc286.technical.amstra: PC3286 Generation 3 leaflet and Amstrad user manual
